tutorial.reignofnether.welcome2: Welcome to the Beyond and Tabs Tutorial!
tutorial.reignofnether.get_started: Press %s (or F12) or use /rts-camera to get started.
tutorial.reignofnether.join: Press Backspace (or F12) to toggle the RTS camera and join the game

tutorial.reignofnether.welcome_back: Welcome back to Beyond and Tabs
tutorial.reignofnether.op_commands: As a server op you may use:
tutorial.reignofnether.sync_disabled1: RTS Syncing has been disabled, so you cannot select buildings or see unit owners, sorry!
tutorial.reignofnether.sync_disabled2: To resolve this, please ask the host to re-enable it, then relog.

tutorial.reignofnether.skipping: Skipping tutorial stage... you are now on: %s
tutorial.reignofnether.ready_continue: Press SPACE when you're ready to continue.
tutorial.reignofnether.rts_view: Welcome to RTS view. Instead of the usual first-person minecraft camera, here we can view the world from a top-down perspective.
tutorial.reignofnether.see_again: TIP: If you want to see any of these messages again, open chat with ENTER or the button on the right.
tutorial.reignofnether.reminder: If at any point you're lost or need a reminder on what to do next, click the button at the top right. Try doing that now to continue.
tutorial.reignofnether.need_click: You needed to click this button, which you just did. Great work!
tutorial.reignofnether.move_camera: To move your camera, move your mouse to the edges of the screen. Try it now.
tutorial.reignofnether.move_camera2: Move your mouse to each edge of your screen until the camera starts moving, as shown by the arrows.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.arrow_keys: TIP: You can also move the camera with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag the map with the middle mouse button.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.zoom: TIP: Scroll to zoom toward the cursor, CTRL+SCROLL to tilt and ALT+MIDDLE-DRAG to rotate the camera. TAB shows the whole map.
tutorial.reignofnether.minimap: Since you could get lost with a top-down view like this, here's a minimap for you to help navigate.
tutorial.reignofnether.map_click: You can move around the world quickly by clicking on a spot on the map. Try doing that now.
tutorial.reignofnether.map_click2: Click a spot on the minimap at the bottom right to move the camera there
tutorial.reignofnether.recenter: If you need to move really far away, you can also SHIFT+CLICK to recentre the map on that location.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.expand_map: TIP: Press M or click the bottom right button to expand the map. The very dark areas are outside the world border.
tutorial.reignofnether.playing_units: It's time to start playing with some units.
tutorial.reignofnether.spawn_villagers: Let's get started by spawning in some villagers here.
tutorial.reignofnether.spawn_villagers2: Click the button at the top right and then click on the ground where you want to place your villagers.
tutorial.reignofnether.worker_units: Villagers are your worker units who can build and gather resources and are essential to starting and maintaining a good base.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_worker2: LEFT-CLICK a villager to select it.
tutorial.reignofnether.move_worker: Now, RIGHT-CLICK where you want to move it.
tutorial.reignofnether.move_worker2: LEFT-CLICK a villager to select it, then RIGHT-CLICK on the ground to move it.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_villagers: Now let's try selecting a group of villagers.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_villagers2: To do this, hold LEFT-CLICK and DRAG your mouse across them, then release to select.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_villagers3: Hold LEFT-CLICK and DRAG your mouse across a group of villagers, then release to select them.
tutorial.reignofnether.move_group: Now, RIGHT-CLICK where you want to move the group.
tutorial.reignofnether.move_group2: With a group of villagers selected, RIGHT-CLICK on the ground to move them.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.select_same: TIP: You can also double click a unit to select all units of the same type.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.deselect: TIP: If you want to deselect your units, press the tilde (~) key
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.grouping: TIP: For you RTS fans, control grouping with CTRL+NUM is also a feature.
tutorial.reignofnether.start_base: It's time to start your base.
tutorial.reignofnether.capitol: The first and most important building of any base is always the capitol.
tutorial.reignofnether.good_spot: This looks like a good spot for it, being flat ground, near lots of resources and with plenty of space around it for other buildings.
tutorial.reignofnether.building_resource: Note that building takes resources. Luckily, the TOP-LEFT shows we have more than enough WOOD and ORE needed.
tutorial.reignofnether.place_capitol: Select your workers, then click the bottom-left button and click on the ground where you want to place your capitol.
tutorial.reignofnether.place_capitol2: Select your workers, then click the bottom-left button and click on the ground to place a town centre.
tutorial.reignofnether.all_workers_build: If they aren't already, you can have all of your villagers help to build to speed up progress. To do this, select your workers and RIGHT-CLICK the building.
tutorial.reignofnether.wait_for_capitol: Just wait for your Town Centre to complete. If your workers stopped building for some reason, just select them and RIGHT-CLICK it to resume.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_building: You can also select the building itself like a unit to see how far along it is in building.
tutorial.reignofnether.congratulations: Congratulations, you now have a base set up!
tutorial.reignofnether.capitols_produce_: Capitols like the Town Centre are the only building that can produce workers like villagers.
tutorial.reignofnether.worker_cost: Note that producing workers takes 50 FOOD each. We should have enough resources for quite a lot
tutorial.reignofnether.rally_point: LEFT-CLICK to select your Town Centre, RIGHT-CLICK to set a rally point - units will automatically go to that spot when they appear.
tutorial.reignofnether.rally_point2: LEFT-CLICK to select your Town Centre, then RIGHT-CLICK on the ground to set a rally point.
tutorial.reignofnether.make_villager: Now let's try making a villager. With your Town Centre selected, click the bottom-left button to start producing one.
tutorial.reignofnether.make_villager2: LEFT-CLICK to select your Town Centre, click the bottom-left button make a villager, then wait for it to be completed.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.queue: TIP: you can queue up as many units to build as you can afford.
tutorial.reignofnether.nice_work_workers: Nice work. Workers are vital for a healthy base!
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.cancel: TIP: you can cancel any in-progress units for a full refund by clicking their icon at the bottom.
tutorial.reignofnether.gather_resources: Now that we have a bunch of workers, we can start gathering some resources.
tutorial.reignofnether.forest: There's a forest over here that we can get wood from.
tutorial.reignofnether.gather_wood: To gather a resource, select a worker, then RIGHT-CLICK a tree.
tutorial.reignofnether.gather_wood2: Select any villager, then RIGHT-CLICK any tree.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.autoreturn: TIP: Workers keep gathering until told to do something else. Once they have at least 50 total resources they return it to the town centre.
tutorial.reignofnether.gather_ore: Now let's do the same thing for ore.
tutorial.reignofnether.beach_ore: Here's a beach with coal and copper we can get ore from.
tutorial.reignofnether.click_ore: Select a worker, then RIGHT-CLICK an ore block.
tutorial.reignofnether.click_ore2: Select any villager, then RIGHT-CLICK any ore block.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.sand_richer: TIP: Sandy biomes like deserts and beaches have more and better ores.
tutorial.reignofnether.gather_food: While your other workers are busy on wood and ore, let's find some food.
tutorial.reignofnether.pigs: Here are some pigs that you can hunt for food.
tutorial.reignofnether.hunt_pig: Just like wood and ore, select a worker and RIGHT-CLICK an animal to start hunting it.
tutorial.reignofnether.hunt_pig2: Select any villager, then RIGHT-CLICK an animal and wait for it to be killed. Make sure that villager doesn't already have a full inventory.
tutorial.reignofnether.empty_pockets: Make sure your worker isn't holding any other resources!
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.dropped: TIP: If your worker can't hold all the food after hunting an animal, it will drop to the ground.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.pick_up: TIP: Dropped items like food and saplings can be picked by any humanoid non-hero unit and returned for resources.
tutorial.reignofnether.return_food: Your villager should now return the food to your town centre, but if they aren't, simply select the villager and RIGHT-CLICK your Town Centre.
tutorial.reignofnether.return_food2: Select your villager that hunted the pig and RIGHT-CLICK your Town Centre.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.max_carry: TIP: Units hold up to 100 total resources, but hunting allows you to go above this maximum.
tutorial.reignofnether.expand_base: Let's expand your base. Some new buildings have been unlocked for you. Select a worker if you haven't already to check them out.
tutorial.reignofnether.new_buildings: Select any worker to check out your new building options.
tutorial.reignofnether.stockpiles: Stockpiles can give your workers a place to drop off resources faster.
tutorial.reignofnether.houses: Houses raise your max unit population. Check the top left for your current totals.
tutorial.reignofnether.farms: Farms give you a slow but renewable source of food in exchange for wood.
tutorial.reignofnether.barracks: Finally, a barracks lets you start training soldiers to fight enemies.
tutorial.reignofnether.check_out_buildin: Let's take some time to check out a few of these buildings.
tutorial.reignofnether.build_barracks: When you're ready, build a barracks and get prepare to train your first army.
tutorial.reignofnether.build_barracks2: Select any villager and build a barracks building at the bottom left. Make sure you've gathered enough wood to afford it!
tutorial.reignofnether.select_barracks: The barracks is one of many buildings that can produce military units. Select your barracks to check them out.
tutorial.reignofnether.select_barracks2: Select your barracks to check out your military unit options
tutorial.reignofnether.vindicators: Vindicators are melee units with high health and moderate damage.
tutorial.reignofnether.pillagers: Pillagers are ranged units which attack slowly but with high damage.
tutorial.reignofnether.produce_illagers: Select your barracks and produce a total of 3 Pillagers and/or Vindicators. If you need more food try building a farm or hunt more animals. If you need more population supply, try building a house.
tutorial.reignofnether.three_units: Try building 3 units from here to continue.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.select_milita: TIP: If you lose track of your military units, you can press K or click the button on the right to select all of them at once.
tutorial.reignofnether.monster_attack: Uh oh, looks like some monsters are about to attack!
tutorial.reignofnether.attack: With your units selected, RIGHT-CLICK an enemy to attack them. Units will also automatically attack nearby enemies if they are idle.
tutorial.reignofnether.defended: Nicely done, you successfully defended your base!
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.death_drops: TIP: During an attack, be sure to protect your workers. If a worker dies while holding resources, it is dropped and can be stolen by your enemies!
tutorial.reignofnether.buildings_damaged: Looks like some of your buildings were damaged in the attack.
tutorial.reignofnether.repair_buildings: Try repairing one of them by selecting a villager, then RIGHT-CLICKING the damaged building. Repairs cost 1 wood for each block.
tutorial.reignofnether.repair_buildings2: Select a worker and RIGHT-CLICK a damaged building, then wait for it to be fully repaired. Repairs cost 1 wood for each block.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.building_heal: TIP: Building health is determined by how many blocks it's made up of. If they have less than half blocks remaining, they are destroyed completely.
tutorial.reignofnether.monster_base: The monsters have a base across the river (but you can't see it yet because fog of war is enabled). We should destroy it before they attack again.
tutorial.reignofnether.monster_base2: The monsters have a base across the river, we should destroy it before they attack again.
tutorial.reignofnether.build_bridge: To cross the river, we need to build a bridge.
tutorial.reignofnether.build_bridge2: This looks like a good spot for one. Select a worker and build a bridge here. You can press [ or ] to rotate the bridge before placement.
tutorial.reignofnether.build_bridge3: Select a worker and build a bridge across the river. You can press [ or ] to rotate the bridge before placement. If the bridge is too short, you can build more segments connecting to it.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.bridge_segmen: TIP: You may need more than one bridge segment to cross the river. After completing one you can connect new segments to it.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.bridges_neutr: TIP: Bridges are always neutral regardless of who built them. This means anyone can attack, repair and connect new segments to them.
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.crossing_brid: TIP: Be very careful when crossing bridges. If it is destroyed while your units are crossing, they will land in the water and be defenceless!
tutorial.reignofnether.reinforcements: Reinforcements have arrived! Use them to crush the enemy base!
tutorial.reignofnether.iron_golem: Your army includes an iron golem and your workers can now build blacksmiths to produce more if needed.
tutorial.reignofnether.destroy_monster_b: Prepare your army and destroy all buildings in the monsters' base
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.ranged_no_bui: TIP: Most ranged units can't attack buildings. Order them to attack units instead!
tutorial.reignofnether.tip.monster_capit: TIP: The monsters' capitol, the Mausoleum, produces an artificial night time around it. If you can destroy it during the day, undead units will burn under the sun.
tutorial.reignofnether.congratulations_t: Congratulations! You have completed the tutorial!
tutorial.reignofnether.continue: You may now continue with all of the buildings and units unlocked.
tutorial.reignofnether.reset_game: To reset the game and try a new faction, type /rts-reset
tutorial.reignofnether.server_hosting: If you would like to play against another player, check out the Reign of Nether CurseForge page for a guide on server hosting.
tutorial.reignofnether.good_luck: Until next time... Good luck and have fun!

onboarding.reignofnether.step.welcome.bo: This short battle teaches you to play. Each step finishes when you do it for real. Already know a step? Press Skip step. The - in the corner folds this panel; Quit ends the lesson (the match stays yours).
onboarding.reignofnether.step.zoom.title: Zoom
onboarding.reignofnether.step.zoom.body: Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in and out. Zooming in goes toward the cursor, so point at what you want to see. Keys: %1$s / %2$s. On a trackpad: two-finger scroll.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.pan.title: Move the camera
onboarding.reignofnether.step.pan.body: Hold the middle mouse button (the wheel) and drag to pull the map around. No middle button, like a Mac mouse? %1$s, the arrow keys, or pushing the cursor against the screen edge all pan too.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.rotate.bod: Hold Alt (Option on a Mac) and middle-drag to rotate and tilt the view - or hold Alt and press A / D. Ctrl + wheel tilts. %1$s puts the camera back to normal.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.overview.b: Press %1$s for the overview of the battlefield. Press it again, or click a spot, to fly back in there.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.select.bod: Left-click your Commander (the ring of light marks it). It builds, fights and carries the D-gun - and if it dies, you lose. The card in the bottom left shows what the selection can do.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.box_select: Hold the left mouse button and drag a box around your workers and Commander. Shift + click adds or removes one unit; a double click selects every unit of that type on screen.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.move.title: Move
onboarding.reignofnether.step.move.body: With units selected, right-click the ground to send them there. Hold Shift while giving orders to queue them one after another.
With two or more units selected, hold the right mouse button and drag a line: they spread out along it. This is how you set up a battle line.
Metal pays for everything. It comes from metal patches - the raw-iron spots on the ground (one is marked). Select your Commander or a worker, pick the %1$s on its card (bottom left) and click it onto the patch. Then wait for it to finish.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.energy.bod: Energy is the second resource: buildings and units spend metal and energy while they are being made. Build a %1$s near your base. The bar at the top shows each pool with its income and spending.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.lab.title: Build a lab
onboarding.reignofnether.step.lab.body: Combat units come from labs. Build a %1$s near your base. Select several workers and they build it together, faster.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.train.body: Select the %1$s and click a unit on its card to train it - train two. With the lab selected, right-click the ground to set where new units walk. (Ironhide Horde: refit the Basic Portal to a Military Portal first.)
onboarding.reignofnether.step.attack_mov: Select your new units, press %1$s, then click the ground (or right-click). They walk there and fight anything they meet on the way - the safe way to move an army.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.reclaim.bo: Wrecks hold metal (a few just appeared, marked). Select workers, hold Ctrl and right-drag a circle over the wrecks: they collect every heap inside it.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.dgun.title: The D-gun
onboarding.reignofnether.step.dgun.body: Select your Commander, press the D-gun button on its card, then click where to fire. It wipes out light units and costs energy, so keep some in the bank. Fire it once.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.kill_comma: %1$s waits at the marked spot and will not attack you. Attack-move your army there and bring your Commander. Killing the enemy Commander wins the game - just as losing yours loses it.
onboarding.reignofnether.step.done.title: Victory - you know the basics
onboarding.reignofnether.step.done.body: Next: press %1$s for the stats table, and %2$s with one unit selected to take control of it yourself. Esc -> Controls lists every key. Try a Skirmish from the title screen. Finish closes this panel; the battlefield stays yours.

onboarding.reignofnether.faction.village: Gold-trimmed knights and crossbows from cathedral keeps. A disciplined army that wins with range and formation.
long range, sturdy melee lines, straightforward units
slow to react; crumbles when flanked or caught spread out
Formation - ranged units standing near two of their own melee fighters hit 25%% harder.
Sun Colossus - a giant gilded paladin whose Solar Lance sweeps a long line. Very slow, no anti-air.
Easy - the clearest way to learn.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.monster: The risen dead from crypts and bone spires. Wins long wars of attrition by raising what falls.
cheap numbers and endurance; wrecks feed the army
fragile one by one; struggles against fast early pressure
Every wreck is an army - the Lich Regent's Raise Dead turns the fallen into fresh troops.
Bone Dragon - soul-fire breath, and what it kills rises for a while. Brittle to blunt damage and anti-air.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.piglins: Rust-iron warbands in bone plate, led by war drums. Wins with mass, weight and the charge.
tough, hard-hitting units and brutal charges
ranged armies that kite them, and fire
Momentum - units moving in a straight line build up to +50%% damage and knockback.
War Mammoth - a woolly titan with an archer platform that tramples lines. Turns slowly; fire panics it.
Easy to start - keep the army moving forward. Refit the Basic Portal to train fighters.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.verdant: Elves and druids of living wood. Wins with speed and with a battlefield it grows itself.
fast units, roots, stealth in thickets
light units that lose a straight fight; fire
Living Terrain - thickets and vines are real blocks the enemy must burn or cut through.
World Tree Walker - a walking oak that plants thickets and heals the Court in its shade. Slow, burns badly.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.tidewro: Corsairs and tide-priests from shipwreck harbours. They bring the sea with them, even onto dry land.
raids and artillery; faster and regenerating on water or tidepools
weaker away from water; draining their tidepools strands them
Tides - Tide Priests raise tidepools anywhere, and Tidewrought units are faster and heal in them.
Leviathan - an armoured sea-beast carrying a fortress: swims fast, walks slowly, leaves tidepools. No anti-air.
Hard - plan around water and tidepools.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.stormca: A mage dynasty of jade towers and pagodas. Energy is mana, and their spells decide the fights.
spells drain energy as they are cast - an empty pool stalls everything
Mana - spells spend energy live; Overcharge empowers them but slows your building.
Celestial Dragon - a storm serpent whose Tempest strikes everything inside it. Costs huge energy; fragile when grounded.
onboarding.reignofnether.faction.brasswo: Dwarven artificer guilds of brass, copper and steam. Durable, upgradeable machines and turrets.
tough war-machines, turrets and field upgrades
slow start - fast raids hurt before the machines are online
Heat and upgrades - Tinkers upgrade machines in the field; heavy fire builds heat that must vent.
Iron Leviathan Engine - a walking foundry-fortress with a heavy cannon that launches drones. Overheats; slow.
Medium - hold early, then roll forward.

entity.reignofnether.elder_druid_unit.to: T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a Seedshaper.
The only Court builder that can raise a Tier 3 lab.
Awaken Thicket: wakes a treant to fight for you for 30 s.
entity.reignofnether.stag_lancer_unit.to: Fast elven cavalry on a great antlered elk.
Leaping Charge bounds over the front line and scatters what it lands on.
entity.reignofnether.shade_ranger_unit.t: A sniper: very long range, one heavy shot at a time, fragile up close.
Fades from sight after standing still for 3 s; every shot gives it away.
entity.reignofnether.elder_treant_unit.t: An ancient walking oak: huge health, very slow.
Hurls a boulder every 8 s that crushes enemies where it lands.
entity.reignofnether.wisp_choir_unit.too: Anti-air: three forest wisps whose bolts deal triple damage to flying units.
Half damage to anything on the ground, and cannot hurt buildings.
entity.reignofnether.bloom_priestess_uni: Support: every 4 s heals all friendly units within 7 blocks for 3 HP.
Her pulse cleanses slows, roots, poison, wither, weakness and glowing.
Bloom (20 s): heals every friend within 8 blocks for 12 HP. Does not fight.
unitstats.reignofnether.harpoon_pull: Every %s throws: pulls the target up to %s blocks closer
buildings.reignofnether.circle_of_elders: A ring of elder trees round a moonlit well: home of the Court's Tier 2 army and the Elder Druid.
Requires a Grove and Tier 2 research.
buildings.reignofnether.storm_oak.toolti: A gnarled oak with a lightning rod in its crown: every %2$s s it calls a bolt (%1$s damage) on one enemy within %3$s blocks, aiming where they crowd.
Requires a Circle of Elders and Tier 2 research.
buildings.reignofnether.heart_of_the_wil: A giant hollow elder tree, a living cathedral: grows the Court's experimental, the World Tree Walker.
Requires a Circle of Elders, Tier 3 research and an Elder Druid to raise it.
entity.reignofnether.world_tree_walker_u: Verdant experimental: a whole elder tree on the march. Its shade heals the Court's units nearby.
Rootquake roots and hurts every enemy around it after a short warning.
Slow and hits softly for its size - and fire burns it for double damage.
entity.reignofnether.embalmer_unit.toolt: T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a worker.
The only builder that can raise your Tier 3 lab.
Tends the dead and the crypts that hold them.
entity.reignofnether.bonewright_unit.too: T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a worker.
The only builder that can raise your Tier 3 lab.
Raises the Horde's great halls from bone and iron.

maps.reignofnether.preset.nether_rift.bl: A lava rift crossed by basalt bridges, capturable lava vents, debris mine
maps.reignofnether.preset.end_spires.blu: End stone islands over the void joined by bridges, obsidian spires
maps.reignofnether.preset.verdant_valley: Rolling meadows, a ring river with fords, forest reclaim lanes and camps
maps.reignofnether.preset.desert_mesa.bl: Open dunes, mesas with high-ground metal, oases that heal

entity.reignofnether.seedshaper_unit.too: A druid of the Verdant Court who raises halls from living wood.
Builds, repairs and reclaims; your first one is the Grove Warden.
Right-click a metal patch to grow an extractor on it.
entity.reignofnether.fox_courier_unit.to: The fastest scout of any court: sharp eyes, a letter in its jaws and a nip for stragglers.
entity.reignofnether.moonwell_bearer_uni: A druid with a lantern of moonwell water: mends the most hurt friends nearby, and more so at night.
entity.reignofnether.owl_watcher_unit.to: A silent flying scout with the longest sight of any T1 unit. It cannot fight.
entity.reignofnether.hive_keeper_unit.to: Releases a swarm of poisonous bees at nearby enemies. Strong against crowds of cheap units.
tide.reignofnether.no_ground: No open ground for a tidepool there
tide.reignofnether.too_many_tidepools: Too many tidepools on the map
entity.reignofnether.leafblade_unit.tool: A fast elven raider. Leaf Dash darts onto a target, cutting whatever it passes.
entity.reignofnether.thornbow_unit.toolt: An elven archer whose thorned arrows root their target in place for a moment.
entity.reignofnether.sentinel_treant_uni: A walking oak that holds the line and shrugs off arrows. Slow, and hits softer than a golem.
buildings.reignofnether.heartwood_hall.t: A living-wood hall round a great oak that grows Seedshapers and Fox Couriers.
Only one capitol can produce workers at any given time.
buildings.reignofnether.grove.tooltip1: A training glade for Leafblades, Thornbows and Sentinel Treants.
entity.reignofnether.shipwright_unit.too: A corsair carpenter who raises harbours from wreck timber and copper.
Builds, repairs, reclaims and drains enemy tidepools; your first one is the Admiral.
Right-click a metal patch to rig an extractor on it.
entity.reignofnether.gull_spotter_unit.t: A trained gull that flies fast and far, seeing farther than any foot scout.
Unarmed: the corsairs' eyes over the next headland.
entity.reignofnether.cutlass_raider_unit: A quick corsair with a cutlass, light and fast.
Ambush: stepping out of water or a tidepool, its next hit within 3 s deals 40% more.
Wade up a Tide Priest's pool and come out swinging.
entity.reignofnether.reef_guard_unit.too: A marine in brass and coral with trident and shield: holds the line.
Its shield turns aside 45% of ranged damage.
Heals 3 HP/s in water or on a tidepool (other Tidewrought: 2).
entity.reignofnether.bombard_crew_unit.t: A gunner lobbing mortar shells that burst 2.5 blocks wide.
Long range, splash, no terrain damage; cannot fire within 6 blocks.
Attack Ground shells a spot. Keep it behind the line.
entity.reignofnether.tide_priest_unit.to: A priestess of the tides with a conch. She does not fight.
Raise Tidepool: shallow water for 30 s on open ground up to 10 blocks away.
On it the Tidewrought run faster and heal. They bring the sea with them.
entity.reignofnether.harpooner_unit.tool: A whaler with a barbed harpoon on a line, 12 blocks of reach.
Every third throw drags the target up to 6 blocks closer. Friends and big beasts are never hauled.
Reel them into the Bombards' range, or onto the Raiders' blades.
entity.reignofnether.flak_swivel_unit.to: A gun crew with a light swivel gun: the corsairs' anti-air.
Bursts do 300% to flying units and only 50% to ground units; picks flyers first.
entity.reignofnether.mudskipper_sloop_un: A great amphibious mudskipper ridden as a raider: quick, light, hard-biting.
On water or a tidepool it is 60% faster (three times the Tides bonus).
Raise a pool to the enemy's flank and let it skip across.
buildings.reignofnether.wreck_harbour.to: A beached galleon made a harbour: trains Shipwrights and Gull Spotters.
Only one capitol can produce workers at any given time.
buildings.reignofnether.slipway.tooltip1: A launching ramp for Cutlass Raiders, Reef Guards, Bombard Crews, Tide Priests, Harpooners, Flak Swivels and Mudskipper Sloops.
buildings.reignofnether.storage_vault.to: Raises storage by %s metal and %s energy, so income is banked instead of wasted.
Fragile: if it falls, whatever it held above your new cap is lost.
T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a Shipwright.
The Tidewrought builder for their future Tier 3 lab.
Raise Great Tidepool: a wide tidepool that lasts 45 s.
A deep-sea mystic with a weak brine lash and the sea's arms at call.
Tentacle Grab: drags an enemy 4 blocks closer and roots it for 2 s (6 blocks and 3.5 s in water or on a tidepool).
Grabs its own target when ready, or pick a priority target yourself.
A great snapping turtle with a mortar on its shell: amphibious heavy artillery.
Out-ranges the Bombard Crew (30 blocks) and hits harder, but cannot fire within 8 blocks.
Slow on land: keep it on water or a tidepool, and keep a gull over its targets.
entity.reignofnether.sky_corsair_unit.to: A pirate airship: flies over the fight and drops a line of three bombs.
The bombs splash enemies and dent their buildings, and never hurt your own side.
It has to fly right over its target: anti-air tears it down.
buildings.reignofnether.drydock.tooltip1: A graving dock under a brass gantry: home of the Tidewrought Tier 2 fleet and the Harbourmaster.
buildings.reignofnether.drydock.tooltip2: Requires a Slipway and Tier 2 research.
buildings.reignofnether.lighthouse_batte: Sees %1$s blocks; its turning beam strips enemies of thicket, fog and cloak cover out to %2$s blocks.
A swivel gun fires %1$s damage every %2$s s at the nearest visible enemy within %3$s blocks.
Requires a Drydock and Tier 2 research.
buildings.reignofnether.abyssal_shipyard: A drydock under the ribcage of a drowned giant: raises the Tidewrought experimental, the Leviathan.
Requires a Drydock, Tier 3 research and a Harbourmaster to lay its keel.
entity.reignofnether.leviathan_unit.tool: Tidewrought experimental: a giant crab-beast with a fortress on its back. Crawls on land, surges in water and on tidepools.
Its wake leaves tidepools for the fleet behind it; Tidal Slam hurls back every enemy in a wide arc after a short warning.
Melee only - no answer to flyers - and artillery and siege crack its fortress for heavy damage.
hud.mana.reignofnether.no_pool: No energy pool to cast from
hud.mana.reignofnether.overcharge_auto_o: Out of energy - Overcharge switched off
entity.reignofnether.geomancer_unit.tool: A red-robed earth mage who raises pagodas from stone and jade.
Builds, repairs and reclaims; your first one is the Thunder Sage.
Right-click a metal patch to raise an extractor on it.
entity.reignofnether.paper_crane_unit.to: A folded-paper crane, sealed in red ink, that flies fast and far and sees farther than any foot scout.
Unarmed: a message that reads the battlefield.
entity.reignofnether.blade_dancer_unit.t: A dancer in red silk with twin sabres, light and fast.
Blink Strike (25 energy, 10 s): teleports beside an enemy up to 9 blocks away and attacks it.
In a fight it blinks onto enemy archers by itself, keeping 150 energy for the Thunder Sage.
entity.reignofnether.fire_adept_unit.too: A fire mage: a small fireball every 2 s at 16 blocks that sets its target burning.
Each shot is a spell: 2 energy (mana). With the pool dry it fires at half rate.
Burns foes, never the ground; boils away tidepools it hits.
entity.reignofnether.jade_guard_unit.too: Lacquered lamellar and a jade tower shield: holds the line.
Jade Mirror: projectiles do 40% less, and 30% of the hit flies back at a shooter within 24 blocks.
entity.reignofnether.wind_monk_unit.tool: A monk in saffron and jade whose gusts tear flyers from the sky: the dynasty's anti-air.
Gusts do 300% to flying units and only 50% to ground units; picks flyers first. 1 energy a gust.
buildings.reignofnether.jade_pagoda.tool: A three-tier pagoda of red columns and jade roofs: trains Geomancers and Paper Cranes.
Only one capitol can produce workers at any given time.
buildings.reignofnether.lotus_academy.to: A walled training court for Blade Dancers, Fire Adepts, Jade Guards and Wind Monks.
entity.reignofnether.tinker_unit.tooltip: A goggled dwarf artificer in a leather apron who raises foundries from stone and brass.
Builds, repairs and reclaims; your first one is the Guildmaster.
Field Upgrade: rivets brass plating or a longer barrel onto a machine, once per machine (30 metal).
entity.reignofnether.gyro_scout_unit.too: A clockwork rotor drone that flies fast and far and sees farther than any foot scout.
Unarmed. A machine: a Tinker can plate it.
entity.reignofnether.steam_runner_unit.t: A boiler on stilt legs: the guild's fast raider, snapping at workers and stragglers.
Heat: every bite adds 10; at 100 it vents for 6 s - no attacks, 25% more damage taken.
A machine: Overclock speeds it up, a Tinker can plate it. Immune to fire.
entity.reignofnether.rifle_squad_unit.to: Dwarven musketeers: a slow, hard-hitting volley at 13 blocks.
People, not a machine: no heat, no upgrades. Cannot attack buildings.
entity.reignofnether.iron_warden_unit.to: A small crewed steam golem in brass plate: heavy, slow, and it cannot be knocked about. Holds the line.
Heat: every swing adds 9; at 100 it vents for 6 s - no attacks, 25% more damage taken.
A machine: Overclock speeds it up, a Tinker can plate it.
entity.reignofnether.flak_cart_unit.tool: A brass flak gun on a cart: the guild's anti-air, 300% damage to flyers and 50% to anything on the ground.
Heat: every burst adds 6; at 100 it vents for 6 s. A machine: a Tinker can plate it or lengthen its barrel.
entity.reignofnether.mortar_crawler_unit: A mortar carriage: lobs a 14-damage splash shell every 5 s out to 22 blocks, blind inside 6. Attack Ground shells a spot.
Heat: every shell adds 25; at 100 it vents for 6 s - four shells, then a breather.
A machine: Overclock speeds it up, a Tinker can plate it or lengthen its barrel.
entity.reignofnether.shield_projector_un: A dwarf with a brass projector pack. Does not fight.
Project Shield: a bubble on a friend for 8 s that soaks 60 projectile damage to it and friends within 3 blocks.
entity.reignofnether.sapper_unit.tooltip: A dwarf with a satchel of charges and a mattock. A poor fighter.
Plant Charge: a charge on an enemy building within 3 blocks; after 4 s it deals 60 building damage.
buildings.reignofnether.foundry_hall.too: A deepslate hall under a brass dome: trains Tinkers and Gyro Scouts.
Only one capitol can produce workers at any given time.
buildings.reignofnether.machine_shop.too: An open workshop under a brass roof: assembles the guild's machines and musters its crews.
entity.reignofnether.ink_scribe_unit.too: A court calligrapher with a brush and a scroll. Does not fight.
Seal (25 energy, 20 s): an enemy unit within 10 blocks can't use abilities for 6 s (commanders 3 s).
Sealed units still move and fight. A Ward protects its allies from the seal.
entity.reignofnether.frost_adept_unit.to: An ice mage: a frost bolt every 2 s at 16 blocks that slows its target (Slowness II, 2 s).
Each bolt is a spell: 2 energy. With the pool dry it fires at half rate.
Frost Field (50 energy, 20 s): freezes the ground round a spot for 15 s; enemies on the ice are slowed.
entity.reignofnether.rocket_battery_unit: Artillery: a volley of 4 rockets every 6 s, 24 blocks, each 5 splash damage over a 3-block spread.
Gunpowder, not mana: costs no energy to fire. Attack Ground shells a spot.
Cannot fire at anything within 7 blocks; never breaks terrain.
hud.mana.reignofnether.sealed: That unit is sealed - it can't use abilities
hud.mana.reignofnether.seal_warded: A Ward protects that unit from the seal
hud.mana.reignofnether.frost_no_ground: No open ground to freeze there
hud.mana.reignofnether.ley_link_first: Ley Link: now click a second building within 16 blocks
buildings.reignofnether.celestial_observ: A pagoda tower crowned with a brass orrery: home of the Stormcallers' Tier 2 and the Ley Master.
Requires a Lotus Academy and Tier 2 research.
entity.reignofnether.ley_master_unit.too: T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a Geomancer.
The Stormcallers' builder for their future Tier 3 lab.
Mana Well (80 energy): spells cast within 10 blocks of the well are 25% stronger and 20% cheaper. Four at most.
entity.reignofnether.thunder_dragon_unit: A jade-and-gold sky serpent. Flies; every 3 s its lightning strikes a foe for 14 and arcs to up to 3 more within 5 blocks, weaker each jump.
Each strike is a spell: 10 energy. With the pool dry it strikes at half rate.
Never arcs to friends; cannot attack buildings. Anti-air brings it down.
entity.reignofnether.earthshaker_unit.to: A jade-veined stone golem: slow, heavy, immovable, and 30% harder to shoot.
Ground Slam (60 energy, 25 s): cracks an 8-block line; after 1 s it heaves, 12 damage and a 2 s root to enemies on it.
The dust marks the line first - a clump that stands still is a clump that is caught.
entity.reignofnether.gravity_monk_unit.t: A monk in violet and gold whose empty hands bend weight: a weak pulse at 10 blocks.
Singularity (50 energy, 25 s): after 1 s, every enemy within 5 blocks of a spot up to 12 blocks away is dragged into it and slowed 2 s.
Big beasts and flyers are only slowed. Follow it with Heaven's Judgement or a Frost Field.
entity.reignofnether.mirror_mage_unit.to: A mage with a bronze mirror. Does not fight.
Mirror Images (80 energy, 30 s): 3 decoys of a friendly ground unit within 10 blocks for 10 s. They draw fire, deal no damage and shatter at a touch.
Never a commander, a flyer or an experimental. Six decoys at most.
buildings.reignofnether.heavens_gate.too: A great jade-roofed gate under a sun disc: raises the Stormcallers' experimental, the Celestial Dragon.
Requires a Celestial Observatory, Tier 3 research and a Ley Master to raise it.
entity.reignofnether.seer_unit.tooltip1: A court astrologer with a lantern staff. Does not fight; sees 36 blocks.
entity.reignofnether.seer_unit.tooltip2: Its lantern strips the cover from cloaked and hidden enemies within 14 blocks every half second, for 3 s.
entity.reignofnether.seer_unit.tooltip3: Thickets, fog banks and a Shade Ranger's cloak all fail near it.
entity.reignofnether.lantern_fortress_un: A slow, armoured elephant hung with lanterns. Does not fight.
Lantern Dome (toggle, 15 energy/s): a dome of light 6 blocks round it soaks up to 300 projectile damage to friends inside.
Starved or spent, the dome collapses and rises again after 5 s. Melee and spells pass through.
entity.reignofnether.phoenix_unit.toolti: A bird of fire. Flies; dives on a foe every 2 s for 6 and sets it burning. Each dive is a spell: 4 energy, half rate when the pool is dry.
Rebirth: the first killing blow leaves it an ember on the ground for 6 s - 30 health, no attack - then it rises at half health.
Kill the ember to deny the rebirth. Cannot attack buildings.
entity.reignofnether.celestial_dragon_un: Stormcallers experimental: a storm serpent of the air. Sky bolts for 20 every 2.5 s (5 energy each).
Tempest (400 energy + 60/s, 45 s): a storm 6 blocks wide rolls toward a spot up to 18 blocks away for 10 s, striking the most clumped foe inside every half second for 18.
Grounded by wind: 40 damage from wind-type anti-air within 5 s brings it down for 8 s - melee reaches it, it takes 50% more, moves at half speed and cannot cast.
hud.mana.reignofnether.mirror_bad_target: Mirror Images needs a friendly ground unit (no commanders, flyers or experimentals)

Must be placed over lava. Only a T2 constructor can build it; it explodes when destroyed.
Steady +%s energy per second, whatever the wind does.
Its shutters close for 8 s when hit: no energy and half damage while shut.
buildings.reignofnether.advanced_solar.t: Steady +%s energy per second, whatever the wind does.
Only a T2 constructor can build it; shutters close for 8 s when hit; it explodes when destroyed.
buildings.reignofnether.assembly_works.t: A brass-roofed assembly hall with a gantry crane and twin smokestacks: home of the Brassworks Tier 2 and the Engineer-Captain.
Requires a Machine Shop and Tier 2 research.
entity.reignofnether.engineer_captain_un: T2 constructor: builds twice as fast, twice the health of a Tinker; raises the guild's Tier 3 lab.
Mends a damaged machine next to it at twice a Tinker's rate (4 HP a second) whenever it is idle.
Keeps the Tinker's Field Upgrade: plating or a longer barrel, once per machine.
entity.reignofnether.field_mason_unit.to: Combat engineer of the cathedral works: plate-armoured, keeps up with the army, builds at 1.5x a worker's power.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Bulwark (V): a friendly building within 8 blocks takes half damage from attackers for 12 s while the Mason stays within 12 of it.
entity.reignofnether.bonesetter_unit.too: Combat engineer of the crypts: cheap, keeps up with the army, reclaims wrecks at Death's double rate.

Bone Graft (V): tears a wreck within 8 blocks apart to mend a friendly unit - 2 HP per metal, up to 50 metal a cast.
entity.reignofnether.wrecker_unit.toolti: Combat engineer of the clans: thick-hided, keeps up with the army, reclaims at the Horde's 1.5x rate.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Tear Down (V): rips down an enemy wall segment, gate or revealed trap within 4 blocks at once and reclaims half its metal.
entity.reignofnether.rootwarden_unit.too: Combat engineer of the Court: the fastest engineer, light in bark mail, builds at 1.5x a worker's power.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Rootwalk (V): sinks for 2 s and rises beside one of your buildings within 40 blocks; hurt or moved while sinking, it fails.
entity.reignofnether.salvager_unit.toolt: Combat engineer of the harbours: quick, keeps up with the army, builds at 1.5x a worker's power.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Salvage Hook (V): hooks a wreck within 16 blocks and reels it to its feet in 1.5 s - anyone can still reclaim it on the way.
entity.reignofnether.jade_mender_unit.to: Combat engineer of the jade towers: light, keeps up with the army, builds at 1.5x a worker's power.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Mending Rite (V): channels 8 HP a second into a friend within 8 blocks for up to 6 s at 15 energy a second; breaks if the Mender is hurt.
entity.reignofnether.pioneer_unit.toolti: Combat engineer of the guilds: a dwarf in riveted brass, the sturdiest engineer, builds at 1.5x a worker's power.
Field repair: mends the most hurt friendly unit within 5 blocks (3 HP a second) whenever it is idle, and reclaims wrecks as it goes.
Builds field defences only - walls, gates, traps and the anti-raid tower - but helps build or repair anything.
Overdrive (V): 3x build power for 8 s - building, reclaim and repair - then the rig vents for 4 s with no work at all.

entity.reignofnether.steam_juggernaut_un: A boiler-plated war engine: 40% of every ranged hit glances off its plates, and nothing knocks it about.
Heat: every gore adds 15; at 100 it vents for 6 s - no attacks, 25% more damage taken.

Enhanced anti-raid tower: %1$s damage a second to the nearest ground enemy within %2$s blocks, %3$s against light units.
Built by a T1 builder once a Machine Shop stands. Holds a raid alone; artillery still outranges it. Cannot hit flyers.
Anti-air tower: %1$s damage a second to the nearest enemy flyer within %2$s blocks. Ignores ground units.
Long reach so fast flyers can't slip past. One target at a time: a big air push needs more than one.
buildings.reignofnether.sky_watch_heavy_: Twin Sky Gun Post
Enhanced anti-air tower: %1$s damage a second to the nearest enemy flyer within %2$s blocks. Ignores ground units.
Built by a T1 builder once a Machine Shop stands. One target at a time.
buildings.reignofnether.flak_brass.toolt: Flak: %4$s damage a second to enemy flyers within %2$s blocks; each burst also hits every flyer within %5$s blocks of the target, %3$s against experimentals.
The answer to a clump of flyers. Ignores ground units. Requires Tier 2 research and a T2 builder.
buildings.reignofnether.wall_fortified_b: A fortified wall segment: blocks movement like a wall, with almost three times the health - heavies and experimentals take far longer to break through.
Built by a T1 builder once a Machine Shop stands. Same footprint as a wall: mixes into a Shift+drag line. Reclaimable.
buildings.reignofnether.trap_mine_enhanc: Enhanced trap, hidden until it fires: a blast of %1$s damage over a wider radius.
Built by a T1 builder once a Machine Shop stands. One spare charge: the first blast rearms itself after 5 s; the second spends the mine.
buildings.reignofnether.trap_snare_enhan: Enhanced trap, hidden until it fires: roots every enemy in a wider patch for %2$s s.
Built by a T1 builder once a Machine Shop stands. One spare charge: the first spring rearms itself after 5 s; the second spends it (repair resets the plate).
buildings.reignofnether.great_forge.tool: A great foundry under a stepped brass roof: casts the Brassworks' experimental, the Iron Leviathan Engine.
Requires an Assembly Works, Tier 3 research and an Engineer-Captain to raise it.
entity.reignofnether.iron_leviathan_engi: Brassworks experimental: a walking foundry-fortress. Its heavy cannon lobs a 38-damage shell every 4 s up to 16 blocks.
Launches 2 clockwork drones every 30 s (4 at most); they fall apart when it does.
Overheats: 35 heat a shell - about 16 s of fire and it vents for 6 s (no cannon, 25% more damage taken). Slow; Sappers and Drill Burrowers hit it twice as hard.
buildings.reignofnether.sun_spire.toolti: Game ender. At full charge a lance of sunlight strikes the nearest enemy capitol: %s-block radius, %s to buildings, %s to units.
The beam's column shows for 5 s first: units can walk out, buildings cannot. Requires the Castle, Tier 3 and a Royal Architect.
buildings.reignofnether.necropolis.toolt: Game ender. At full charge %s undead rise round the nearest enemy capitol for its owner; they crumble after %s s.
Every wreck near the target adds one more (at most %s). Requires the Stronghold, Tier 3 and an Embalmer.
buildings.reignofnether.game_ender.toolt: Announced to every player when placed. Once built it charges through %s stages of %s s; every 10%% of its health lost knocks one stage off.
A charged enemy Ward Spire near the target intercepts the strike. Then it charges again.
buildings.reignofnether.ward_spire.toolt: The counter to game enders: stores one interception (charges in %s s) and stops a game ender's strike aimed within %s blocks of it.
One charge stops one strike - a second needs a second ward or a recharge. Requires Tier 2.
server.reignofnether.game_ender_started: %s has begun building a %s at x %s, z %s! Scout it, raid it, or build a Ward Spire.
server.reignofnether.game_ender_raided: Your %s was raided and lost charge: stage %s of %s.
server.reignofnether.game_ender_aimed: %s's %s is fully charged and aimed at %s! Five seconds.
server.reignofnether.game_ender_intercep: The %s's strike (%s) was intercepted by %s's Ward Spire.
entity.reignofnether.oriflamme_elephant_: A tusked war elephant under the sun banner. Oriflamme: friendly units within 8 blocks deal 20% more damage and take 15% less.
Slow, and only 9 damage of its own - the aura dies with it, so the enemy will focus it.
entity.reignofnether.gorehorn_rhino_unit: An iron-plated rhino. Breach Charge: charges 14 blocks down a lane, goring (16) and flinging every enemy in it.
The first building in the way stops it and takes 120. The lane shows first; 25 s cooldown.
entity.reignofnether.ossuary_behemoth_un: A hog-shaped heap of bones. Grave Feast: eats a wreck nearby every second for a Bone Stack (max 6).
Each stack: +45 max HP, +1.5 damage, a bigger body - and the wreck's metal is gone. Weak until it has fed.
entity.reignofnether.mossback_bison_unit: A great bison with a living grove on its back. Hollow Grove: carries up to 4 friendly infantry (Embark / Eject).
Riders take half damage, heal 2 HP/s and archers keep shooting. If it falls they spill out.
entity.reignofnether.shellback_turtle_un: An island-turtle with a timber fort on its shell. Moor: anchors in 2 s - half damage, a tidepool round it (the Tides bonus for the fleet), and its deck battery fires.
Deck battery: 12 every 2 s at 4-16 blocks; buildings when no unit is in range. It can't hit what stands at its shell.
Anchored it can't move or bite, and weighing anchor takes 2 s. Drain its pool, flank it, out-range it.
entity.reignofnether.jade_qilin_unit.too: The jade-scaled beast of good omen: a walking Mana Well. Spells your side casts within 10 blocks of it cost 20% less and hit 25% harder.
Mana Spring: +6 energy a second while it lives.
An Ink Scribe's Seal silences both. Light hooves, no ranged attack - the enemy will hunt it.
entity.reignofnether.steam_hauler_unit.t: A traction engine. Field Foundry: mends every friendly machine within 8 blocks for 3 HP a second (haulers don't stack).
Drop Turret: sets a free Deployed Turret within 6 blocks (25 s cooldown, +35 heat).
Repairs heat it faster than it cools: at 100 it vents for 6 s - no repairs, no turrets, 25% more damage taken.
buildings.reignofnether.doom_forge.toolt: Game ender. At full charge a star falls on the nearest enemy capitol: %s-block radius, %s to buildings, %s to units, then the crater burns for %s s.
Stoked with metal: every stage burns %s metal up front and waits while you can't pay. Requires the Fortress, Tier 3 and a Bonewright.
buildings.reignofnether.world_seed.toolt: Game ender. At full charge a Heartroot bursts up at the nearest enemy capitol and %s blocks round it turn to grove for %s s: enemy buildings take %s a second.
Enemy units there are slowed and hurt, yours heal. The grove dies with the Heartroot (%s HP). Requires the Heart of the Wild, Tier 3 and an Elder Druid.
buildings.reignofnether.maelstrom_engine: Game ender. At full charge a whirlpool opens at the nearest enemy capitol: everything within %s blocks is dragged in and battered for %s s.
It drinks from a ring of %s tidepools it floods round itself: every drained pool slows the charge. Requires the Abyssal Shipyard, Tier 3 and a Harbourmaster.
buildings.reignofnether.heavens_bell.too: Game ender. At full charge its toll calls a %s s lightning storm over the nearest enemy capitol (%s-block radius): units first, then buildings.
Every stage costs %s energy up front and waits while you can't pay. Requires Heaven's Gate, Tier 3 and a Ley Master.
buildings.reignofnether.earthcracker.too: Game ender. At full charge a fault line %s blocks long splits the ground through the nearest enemy capitol along the drill's bearing: %s to every building on it.
The drill vents for %s s after each stage - no charge, and raids hit it twice as hard. Requires the Great Forge, Tier 3 and an Engineer-Captain.

server.reignofnether.heavens_bell_starve: Your %s is silent: each stage costs %s energy.
server.reignofnether.earthcracker_ventin: %s's %s is venting for %s s: it can't charge and raids hit it twice as hard.
ability.reignofnether.skyward_shot.toolt: Shoots the nearest enemy flyer within %2$s blocks (the one you ordered it to attack first): %1$s damage a second, while it keeps fighting on the ground.
Enough to stop a light air raid on the commander; an air army still needs anti-air.
Click to switch it off or on. Hold Fire also stops it.
